records.text: On June 19, Erika Kirk deleted 126 Instagram posts, according to Social Blade.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: another interesting thing which I didn't introduce as I've been building out this timeline in the background is that on June 19th, Erika purges her Instagram. ... She deletes 126 Instagram posts. By no means a little. That is according to Social Blade.

verification.notes: The statement accurately attributes the number to Social Blade in the transcript, but current live research could not verify the historical June 19 change. Social Blade's public page now requires login for historical Instagram statistics and exposes only current/last-14-day values; exact searches found no independent archive of the claimed 126-post deletion.
